runner.note: stop_on_malformed_output implements the frozen protocol's stop condition 'if an episode times out or produces malformed output'. It is the one point where the frozen documents disagree: e01-records-scorer-v1 defines invalid_json and schema_or_parse_error classes, which a stopped run cannot reach.
